title: 1670 Tours: Private Walking Tours of Charleston, SC
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Charleston's rich history and vibrant culture on a private walking tour tailored just for you. With a knowledgeable and licensed guide, stroll through the historic district and discover the city's stunning architecture, gardens, and hidden gems. Delve into Charleston's intriguing past, from its wars to its architectural marvels, while enjoying personalized insights and anecdotes. This leisurely tour offers an intimate experience, perfect for individuals, families, or corporate groups.

- Private tours allow for a personalized pace and focus on your interests
- Experienced local guides provide in-depth knowledge of Charleston's history
- Explore iconic sites including private homes, churches, and graveyards
- Suitable for any group size, with customized itineraries available
